title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Studying and Implementing the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Studying and Implementing the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China

Fa [2018] No. 307

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

On October 26, 2018, the Sixth Session of the Standing Committee of the Thirteenth National People's Congress deliberated and adopted the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China. To correctly implement the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts, the relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. Fully understand the great significance of the revision of the Organic Law of the People's Courts

The Organic Law of the People's Courts is an important law that stipulates the institutional setup, organization, and functions of the people's courts, and guarantees that the people's courts perform their duties in accordance with the law. It has a fundamental position in the construction of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Party Central Committee has made major strategic deployments for comprehensively deepening judicial system reforms, achieving a series of significant results that need to be confirmed and reflected in legislative form, primarily in the Organic Law of the People's Courts. The revision of the Organic Law of the People's Courts is a major achievement in implementing Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the Party Central Committee's requirements for comprehensively governing the country by law and deepening judicial system reforms. It promotes a more standardized court setup, a more完善的 trial organization, a more scientific operation mechanism of judicial power, and better guarantees for the exercise of power. It has significant practical and realistic significance for modernizing the trial system and trial capacity of the people's courts and improving a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system.

2. Thoroughly study, implement, and enforce the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts

(1) Comprehensively and accurately study and implement the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts. People's courts at all levels must comprehensively and accurately comprehend the legislative spirit and main content of the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts, seriously study the major adjustments in the new law regarding the working principles, organizational system, institutions, and functions of the people's courts, combine the study and implementation of the new law with deepening supporting reforms of the judicial system, and effectively use it to guide trial enforcement, judicial reform, team building, and other work.

(2) Strengthen the construction of the organizational system and continue to advance the reform of the internal institutions of courts. Further strengthen the construction of the organizational system of the people's courts, reform and improve the functional positioning of the four-level courts, and strengthen the trial supervision and guidance of higher courts over lower courts. Strengthen and standardize judicial interpretation work, strengthen case guidance work, and ensure the uniformity of legal application standards. Within courts, criminal trial divisions, civil trial divisions, administrative trial divisions, and trial supervision divisions shall be established according to trial needs; comprehensive trial divisions may also be established, or no trial divisions may be established. Comprehensive trial business institutions for trial work research and guidance, trial management, etc., shall be established. Trial support institutions such as enforcement implementation, judicial police, litigation services, and information technology shall be established. Judicial administrative management institutions such as comprehensive administration, organizational personnel, and accounting equipment may be established, or comprehensive management institutions may be established.

(3) Firmly implement the judicial accountability system and advance the reform of the adjudication committee system. Strictly implement the principle of "Let those who adjudicate make the judgment, and let those who make the judgment bear the responsibility," effectively implement the overall requirements of the judicial accountability system, promote classified management of personnel, establish and improve a judicial power operation mechanism with unified rights and responsibilities, and implement the responsibilities of judges. Improve the operation mechanism of the adjudication committee, scientifically define the functions of the adjudication committee. Rationalize the relationship between the adjudication committee and the specialized committees, clarifying that specialized committee meetings are one form of adjudication committee meetings. Clarify the relationship between the collegial panel and the adjudication committee, and strictly regulate the initiation procedures for the adjudication committee to discuss and decide cases.

(4) Ensure alignment with the Judges Law, and effectively strengthen the regularization, professionalization, and professional development of the judge corps. Strictly regulate the procedures and conditions for becoming a judge. Newly appointed judges must undergo professional ability review by the judge selection committee. The president of a court shall possess legal professional knowledge and legal professional experience; vice presidents and members of the adjudication committee shall be selected from among judges, prosecutors, or other personnel meeting the relevant conditions. Establish a judge selection mechanism; judges of higher people's courts shall generally be selected on a competitive basis from judges of lower people's courts. Strengthen provincial-level management of judge staffing quotas, ensure that outstanding judges are assigned to frontline case-handling positions, ensure that the number of judges matches the number of cases, and ensure that the number of trial support personnel matches the number of judges. Strengthen information technology construction, do a good job in judge training, and improve trial work efficiency.

(5) Continuously strengthen external and internal supervision of courts, and strengthen guarantees for judges' performance of duties. External supervision of courts mainly refers to the supervision of the work of people's courts at the corresponding level by the people's congresses and their standing committees at all levels, the supervision of the trial work of local people's courts at all levels and specialized courts by the Supreme People's Court, the supervision of the trial work of lower people's courts by higher people's courts, and the supervision of the work of people's courts by the people. Internal supervision of courts mainly refers to the situation where a people's court discovers illegal activities in its own trial activities, it shall promptly investigate and verify and handle them according to law. Any unit or individual shall not require judges to engage in matters beyond the scope of their statutory duties, ensuring that judges are dedicated to adjudication work. Resolutely prevent external personnel from interfering in judicial activities, meddling in the handling of specific cases, or internal court personnel inquiring about cases. Take necessary measures to maintain court order and trial authority, and urge parties to perform judgments and rulings of the people's courts according to law. Improve and implement the judge professional guarantee system, and implement supporting treatment policies for judges.

(6) Ensure alignment with the three major procedural laws, and exercise judicial power independently according to law. Accurately grasp the basic working principles of the people's courts, exercise judicial power independently according to law, and in accordance with the provisions of the Organic Law of the People's Courts, the Civil Procedure Law, the Administrative Procedure Law, and the newly revised Criminal Procedure Law, do a good job in handling criminal cases, civil cases, administrative cases, and other cases stipulated by law, adhere to fair justice, and strive to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

3. Organize the publicity and training work of the Organic Law of the People's Courts

People's courts at all levels must attach great importance to the publicity and training work on the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts. In accordance with the deployment of the Supreme People's Court, take forms such as centralized rotation training and special lectures to organize all court staff to study the new provisions, comprehend the new spirit, accurately understand and grasp the legislative intent and applicable conditions, and promptly report the learning situation to the Supreme People's Court.

During the process of studying, implementing, and publicizing the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts, people's courts at all levels encountering new issues and new situations shall, in light of trial practice, conduct in-depth investigation and research, propose handling opinions, and promptly report to the Supreme People's Court.

November 8, 2018
